svg.aria-label: WayClub. Live preview · in development. Teams, clubs and communities run events, tickets and the committee work behind them in one place, not across group chats, forms and spreadsheets. Built with Next.js, NestJS and PostgreSQL. The screenshot shows the committee workspace for a fictional film society, with a running event and decisions waiting.
